title: wuyou
summary: Termux-first local web coding agent installed from the APK payload as a global command.

locations.purpose: Global standalone wuyou launcher installed from APK payload
APK payload unpack directory and install/check scripts

ai.description: wuyou can be started directly from Termux with `wuyou`; it does not require service-manager and is not registered as a long-running service by default.
ai.whenUnavailable: Run `bash ~/.smallphoneai-bootstrap/bootstrap.sh components` or `SMALLPHONEAI_COMPONENT_TARGETS=wuyou bash ~/.smallphoneai-bootstrap/bootstrap.sh components`, then check `command -v wuyou && wuyou --help`.
